description:
Stop arranging windows pixel by pixel. Mac Window Manager gives you fast, predictable control over your workspace with customizable keyboard shortcuts and drag-to-edge snapping.

ARRANGE WINDOWS YOUR WAY

• Snap standard app windows into halves, corners, thirds, fourths, and sixths
• Center, maximize, resize, and restore windows instantly
• Move windows between displays without breaking your flow
• Drag to screen edges and corners for visual snap targets
• Customize keyboard shortcuts and snap-area behavior

BUILT FOR DAILY MAC WORK

Keep Window Manager close from the menu bar, Dock, or Command-Tab. Launch it automatically at login, choose the layouts that match your workspace, and spend less time dragging window edges.

LOCAL BY DESIGN

Window Manager runs on your Mac without an account. It includes no analytics, advertising, behavioral tracking, or network update service. Your window activity and preferences stay on your device.

ACCESSIBILITY PERMISSION

macOS requires Accessibility permission before Window Manager can move or resize other applications' windows. The app explains this during setup and links directly to the correct System Settings panel.

OPEN SOURCE FOUNDATION

Window Manager is derived from the MIT-licensed Rectangle project. Upstream attribution and license information are included with the app.
promotionalText: Snap, resize, and organize Mac windows in seconds with customizable shortcuts, drag-to-edge layouts, multi-display controls, and zero tracking.
